name: Acceptance test 12 - wildcard action expansion (iam:* de-flood)
note: IAM-705: iam:* covers every IAM action, so the rule + escalation engines expand it into WILDCARD-ACTION, WILDCARD-RESOURCE, DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN, and every specific IAM escalation primitive (ATTACH-POLICY, PUT-INLINE-POLICY, POLICY-VERSION, TRUST-POLICY-MODIFY, CREDENTIAL-CREATION) - 7 near-duplicate rows. The analyzer must present ONE primary broad-IAM-administration finding (DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN) with the specific primitives + the iam:* WILDCARD-ACTION folded in as subsumed techniques / risk factors (reusing the test-23 subsumption mechanism), not a flood of redundant rows. Severity stays high per the single documented IAM-102 scoring model (critical is reserved for compound privilege-boundary-crossing paths). The rule-catalog version must be surfaced on the result.
